author: feenberg
body:
I included Form 8959 line 24 because it copies to form 1040 line 25c, 
which is included in Form 1040 line 33 parallel to the refundable portions 
of the EIC and ACTC. But you are right, it is different as it is actually 
part of FICA not general revenue. I will fix that.

Thanks
Dan
